description: This file contains PHP classes and functions for computing HTML differences using an XML parser, representing HTML DOM nodes, and producing a visual HTML diff output, specifically for the 'daisydiff' library within a third-party directory.

classes.name: LastCommonParentResult
classes.description: Holds information about the last common parent of two DOM nodes during tree diffing.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Represents a change (addition, removal, or modification) in the diff output.

classes.name: DomTreeBuilder
classes.description: Builds a DOM-like tree structure from parsed HTML input, used as part of the diffing process.

classes.name: TextNodeDiffer
classes.description: Handles diffing of text nodes between old and new DOM trees, marking changes.

classes.name: HTMLDiffer
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing HTML, diffing two versions, and producing a diff output.

classes.name: TextOnlyComparator
classes.description: Compares text nodes extracted from HTML trees to determine similarity.

classes.name: AncestorComparator
classes.description: Compares the ancestry of DOM nodes to assist in diffing.

classes.name: ChangeTextGenerator
classes.description: Generates a textual description of differences between node ancestors.

classes.name: ChangeText
classes.description: Builds a string of HTML representing the diff changes visually.

classes.name: TagToStringFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating string representations of DOM tags with change semantics.

classes.name: TagToString
classes.description: Converts DOM tags into descriptive strings for diff output.

classes.name: NoContentTagToString
classes.description:
Special string representation for void or no-content tags like
, .

classes.name: AnchorToString
classes.description: String representation for anchor tags with special handling for 'href' attribute.

classes.name: HTMLOutput
classes.description: Generates the final HTML diff output with styling to highlight changes.

classes.name: ContentHandler
classes.description: Handles generating HTML content during the diff output process.

methods.name: htmlDiff
methods.description: Main method to compute the difference between two HTML strings, returning a styled HTML diff and the number of differences.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Pre-processes the range differences to merge adjacent changes for readability.

methods.name: score
methods.description: Heuristic scoring function to evaluate the merging of differences based on size.

methods.name: diffDebug
methods.description: Appends debug information to internal debug output.
